We are looking for a creative and skilled colleague to join the team and help in the development process of these systems. Would you love a wider exposure across multiple IP products? Do you want an opportunity to work globally with various internal teams to deliver innovative systems? Join our team to help us craft the future products together! Responsibilities As a Hardware engineer, you will be involved in the verification process of IoT, Mobile and Infrastructure subsystems integrating the latest Arm IPs as we are targeting to reach maximum efficiency in terms of power consumption, performance and area while ensuring correct functional behaviour. Your key responsibilities and tasks will include design/verification activities meant to fulfill the project requirements. Collaboration with architecture, design, verification, performance analysis, implementation and various IP is essential as we work together on enabling our partners' success. A mentor will guide your way making sure that your journey in the project and company is a success. Essential Skills and Experience You graduated from a University or Engineering School, in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electronic/Electrical Engineering, or other related; You already have some experience in Hardware or Software development; Proficiency in both written and spoken English. Desirable Skills and Experience It is not required to tick all the boxes below, however the following skills can be a big plus: Practical experience of working on microprocessor or complex system designs; Understanding of design or verification methodologies and techniques; Hands-on experience with System Verilog UVM or a good understanding of object-oriented programming; Familiar with embedded C, assembly and compilers; Knowledge of basic scripting languages, e.g. Perl/TCL/Python; Experience with Linux, shell scripts and Makefiles; Knowledge of Verilog or VHDL; Experience with version control systems such as Git.
